body: Any chance you can single-step through the code and see what function call that acts up?

bisected to f0fe66f @snikulov , original error:
curl: (38) LDAP local: bind via ldap_win_bind Invalid DN Syntax
error changed to "no memory" after 1b443a7 @samsinsane

My apologies, I can see the issue is that it's valid for `conn->data->state.up.query` to be `NULL`, but at the time I assumed that `query` being `NULL` meant that there was a memory allocation failure. I think that [this](https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/44c9884552ad740fcec60d334f9601b205bf5b25/lib/ldap.c#L864) condition needs to also check if `conn->data->state.up.query` is not `NULL` and everything should just work? I won't have time to make this change and test it out for awhile, so someone else might need to do this.

issue.title: Error of curl_fetch_memory with LDAP

repository.name: curl
repository.description: A Modern and Flexible Web Client for R

issue.body:
Hello @jeroen ,

I'm trying to query LDAP with ``curl_fetch_memory``  for a small LDAP R client i'm drafting [here](https://github.com/eblondel/ldap4R). For now, i've tried it with ``RCurl``, but I would like to avoid relying on it, and would prefer using ``curl`` instead.

I'm trying to reproduce ```RCurl:getURL("ldap://localhost:389")``` that works, with ``curl``:

```{r}
h <- new_handle()
curl_fetch_memory("ldap://localhost:389",h)
```
but I get an error: 

```{r}
Error in curl_fetch_memory("ldap://localhost:389", h) : 
  LDAP local: Mémoire insuffisante
```

To test this locally i'm using a test LDAP docker image available with : 
```
docker pull rroemhild/test-openldap
docker run --privileged -d -p 389:389 rroemhild/test-openldap
```

Thanks a lot if you can help figuring out what's wrong,

Best
Emmanuel

body:
This problem has also been reported in the R bindings. This image can be used to reproduce:

```sh
docker run --privileged -d -p 389:389 rroemhild/test-openldap
```

And then: 

```sh
curl "ldap://localhost:389"
# Error: LDAP local: No Memory
```
